verdict.rationale: Zapier ships an official MCP server (zapier.com/mcp) that exposes connected app actions across 9,000+ apps as callable MCP tools to any MCP-compatible client (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor), with governed/managed access and account-level controls documented for IT admins. This directly matches the story of exposing workflow/app actions as MCP tools for external agents. missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of the MCP server's reliability/tool-call behavior beyond first-party docs.
